summary.en: Share coding-agent instructions and dependency maintenance across Cursor, Claude Code and Codex; prevent duplicate runtime pip updates and retain all Python matrix results.
summary.zh: 统一 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 的协作入口与依赖维护流程，避免重复扫描运行时依赖，并保留全部 Python 矩阵结果。

compatibility.en: No game, save, configuration or NPC adapter protocol changes; no global agent settings or model routing changes. Host rule loading is documented, not live-host certification.
compatibility.zh: 不修改游戏、存档、配置或 NPC 适配协议，不更改全局 Agent 设置或模型路由；说明规则加载方式，不宣称已实测所有宿主。

reason: Documents coding-tool entry points and dependency PR handling without changing gameplay.
